list.name: instance_name
list.query: SELECT instance_name FROM dpa.mssql_instance ORDER BY 1

list.name: query_hash
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT query_hash FROM dpa.v_mssql_query_impact_1h WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' AND query_hash IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::numeric AS samples FROM dpa.mssql_request_sample WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' AND sample_time >= now() - interval '1 hour'
SELECT count(*)::numeric AS advisories FROM dpa.mssql_advisory WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' AND advisory_time >= now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT count(*)::numeric AS plan_changes FROM dpa.v_mssql_plan_changes_24h WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name'
SELECT count(*)::numeric AS blocking_episodes FROM dpa.mssql_blocking_episode WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' AND sample_time >= now() - interval '6 hours'

SELECT database_name, query_hash, query_plan_hash, wait_type, program_name, samples, active_seconds, impact_score, left(sample_query_text, 400) AS query_text_sample FROM dpa.v_mssql_query_impact_1h WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' AND ('$query_hash' = 'All' OR query_hash = '$query_hash') ORDER BY impact_score DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT advisory_time, severity, category, database_name, query_hash, query_plan_hash, signal, recommendation, impact_score FROM dpa.v_mssql_advisory_queue WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' AND ('$query_hash' = 'All' OR query_hash = '$query_hash') ORDER BY impact_score DESC, advisory_time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT database_name, query_hash, plan_count, first_seen, last_seen, query_plan_hashes FROM dpa.v_mssql_plan_changes_24h WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' AND ('$query_hash' = 'All' OR query_hash = '$query_hash') ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT snapshot_time, database_name, query_hash, query_plan_hash, statement_context, execution_count, total_worker_time_us, total_elapsed_time_us, total_logical_reads, total_physical_reads, total_logical_writes, total_rows, last_execution_time, left(query_text, 1200) AS query_text FROM dpa.mssql_query_snapshot WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' AND ('$query_hash' = 'All' OR query_hash = '$query_hash') ORDER BY snapshot_time DESC, total_elapsed_time_us DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT snapshot_time, database_name, query_hash, query_plan_hash, plan_handle, left(query_plan, 2000) AS query_plan_xml FROM dpa.mssql_plan_snapshot WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' AND ('$query_hash' = 'All' OR query_hash = '$query_hash') ORDER BY snapshot_time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT sample_time, database_name, blocked_session_id, blocking_session_id, wait_type, wait_time_ms, wait_resource, blocked_query_hash, blocking_query_hash, login_name, host_name, program_name FROM dpa.mssql_blocking_episode WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' ORDER BY sample_time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT sample_time, database_name, category, metric_name, object_name, status, value, details FROM dpa.v_mssql_ops_latest WHERE instance_name = '$instance_name' ORDER BY category, metric_name, value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200
